title: רבא בר בר חנא

paragraphs: Rava bar bar Hana. There were two: one Rava with an aleph, and one Rabbah with a heh (see above, R' Abba bar bar Hana). There is necessary support for this at the end of Havit, the end of Kol Ha-Yad, and Pesahim, Makom She-Nahagu, 51a, where this Rava bar bar Hana was in Abaye's time. When bar bar Hana came to Babylonia, Rav Avira the Elder (it should read Rav Avya the Elder) and Rabbah bar Rav Huna visited him, and he ate the fat on the stomach's curvature. They came and told Abaye, etc. Bar bar Hana told his son that he had seen R' Yohanan eat it, and he was worthy to be relied upon. Bar bar Hana said, ‘R' Yohanan’—it should read Yonatan—‘ben Elazar told me that he followed R' Shimon bar R' Yosi ben Lekonya,’ etc., who saw R' Shimon ben Yohai eating aftergrowths of cabbage in the sabbatical year (see there). Bar bar Hana spoke to Abaye: Eruvin 45a. Before R' Ammi and R' Assi: Kol Ha-Basar, 106a. He was R' Yohanan's pupil. All the episodes in Ha-Sefinah belong to Rava bar bar Hana. But our reading in all the episodes he saw in Ha-Sefinah is Rabbah bar bar Hana; he came before R' Elazar and related them. It appears that Rabbah bar bar Hana, who related the episodes before R' Elazar, was R' Yohanan's pupil, since R' Elazar was in the Land of Israel, whereas the second bar bar Hana was in Babylonia. Tosafot, Sanhedrin 5a, write: bar bar Hana, who was in R' Yohanan's days, was Hana's grandson, hence ‘bar bar.’ Some say his father's name was bar Hana. This cannot be, since in Ha-Sefinah it says ‘Every bar Hana’—Maharsha's reading; our reading is ‘every bar bar’—‘is a fool.’ End quotation. Yuhasin writes [under aleph] that he is not bar bar Hana, R' Hiyya's nephew. Abba bar bar Hana and Rav Huna the priest sat eating, while Ze'ira, his son, stood and served them (see there). Ilfa, or Iffa, told him, ‘You are R' Yohanan's pupils’ (see there). As for his being called Rava bar bar Hana, his name was Abba. The Arukh, entry אביי, writes that Rabbah and Rava are two names, Abbah and Abba; the resh at the beginning is a sign of the title Rav, in a shortened form. See the introductory Rules. Rashbam, Bava Batra 74a, likewise writes: ‘His name is Abba; Ravina's name is R' Avina.’ End quotation. Rabbah bar bar Hana: his sons were Rav Shmuel and Rav Yosef. R' Hiyya's nephew. When he went down to Babylonia, R' Hiyya told Rabbi, ‘My brother's son is going down to Babylonia.’ R' Hiyya (it should read Rabbi) authorized him to judge and permit firstborn animals: Sanhedrin 5a. See above, Abba Arikha. She'erit Yosef, folio 35, writes in Rashba's name that bar bar Hana and Rav were Rabbi's and R' Hiyya's pupils. In Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ha-Gozel U-Ma'akhil: R' Ba bar Hana said, ‘Was not R' Hiyya my uncle,’ etc.; in Shor She-Nagah Et Ha-Parah, 5:5 [source cites halakhah 6]: Abba bar Rav Hana. His wife died in Rav's time: Hezkat Ha-Battim (see Marta). The porters who broke bar bar Hana's wine barrel—this is Ein Yaakov's reading, whereas Heilprin reports Rabbah bar Hanan in his text [the checked Bavli reads Rabbah bar bar Hanan]—Rav ruled that he should pay them, because ‘You shall keep the paths of the righteous’; end of Ha-Umanin. He gave Rav money to buy him land, and Rav bought it for himself: Kiddushin 59a. He came to Pumbedita and did not attend Rav Yehudah's lecture. Rav Yehudah sent Adda the attendant and brought him by force. He told him, ‘Thus Rav Hana of Baghdad said that Shmuel said’: Shabbat 148a. He traveled with a caravan and forgot to recite the blessing. He said he had forgotten a golden dove, returned to bless at the place where he had eaten, and found a golden dove: Berakhot 53b. He became ill, and Rav Yehudah and Rabbah visited him; another version has ‘and the rabbis’: Gittin 16b. He apparently applied to himself [ותרא, conjecturally וקרא] “No harm will befall the righteous”: Avodah Zarah 39a.
Since there are two, as above, discern wisely according to the order of generations.

He spoke to Abaye (see above). Adda bar bar Hana. R' Avya the Elder (see above). Ilfa, or Iffa. R' Elazar bar bar Hana: so Yuhasin writes under aleph; I have not found him mentioned. [In the checked Yuhasin, Rabbah bar bar Hana says he saw R' Elazar of Nineveh.] R' Elazar said: beginning of Ellu Megallehin. He walked behind R' Elazar: Shabbat 12b; brought a bill of divorce before him: Gittin 5, end of b. He stood before R' Ammi and R' Assi (see above). Also R' Zeira and R' Ammi: Megallehin; Ze'ira bar Rav Huna (see above). R' Hiyya said: Bava Batra 124, end of a. R' Hana of Baghdad said (see there). R' Hana Sha'ona, or bar Sha'ona, said that bar bar Hana said that R' Yohanan said. R' Hanina spoke to him: Mo'ed Katan 21a. Bar bar Hana thought to institute them at Sura [Heilprin: Sira]; Rav Hisda spoke to him: Berakhot, first chapter, 12a. R' Yoshiya of Usha spoke to him. He did not attend Rav Yehudah's lecture (see above). R' Yehoshua ben Levi said: Berakhot 24b; Megillah 12, end of b; Hullin 45a. He asked R' Yohanan a teaching: Bava Kamma 17a. R' Yohanan said: Berakhot 13b, 23a, 24b, 25a, 35b, 40b, 42b, 45b, 49a, 55a; Arvei Pesahim 114a; Ha-Mafkid 38a. R' Yonatan ben Elazar spoke to him (see above). Rav Yosef in his name: Bava Kamma 51b; Rav Yosef asked him: Eruvin 78a. Rav Yosef bar bar Hana. Rav Yitzhak was his son. Rav Yitzhak bar Rav Yehudah was in his time. In R' Mani's name: Bava Kamma 51b. Rav Nahman called him ‘bar Hevron,’ spoke in his name, and Yalta, Rav Nahman's wife, showed him blood. Ulla said: end of Mi She-Hehshikh; he was his colleague (see there). Rav Pappa bar Shmuel (see there). He taught before Rav: Shabbat 50a. Rav sent him a severed windpipe: Hullin 44b; there, 77b, Tosafot's reading is bar Rav Hanan. Rav in Abba bar Hana's name; some say Abba bar Hana in Rav's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, end of Ellu Devarim, and Megillah 1:9 [source cites the end of halakhah 11]. Rabbah bar Rav Huna (see above). Rabbi said: Niddah 47a. Rami bar Hama spoke to him. Shmuel said: Shabbat 104b; he asked him: Hullin 48a. R' Shmuel bar Marta said. He arranged a match for his son in Rav Shmuel bar Katina's household. Also R' Shmuel bar Nahmani. Rav Shmuel bar bar Hana. Resh Lakish said: Pesahim 18a, 76b; Hullin 22a; Menahot 83a. Rav Tahlifa bar bar Hana.
